title: The Quiet Studio
summary: Eleven essays on building an independent creative practice that grows slowly and lasts.
description: The Quiet Studio is a collection of essays written over five years of running a one-person studio. It covers the unglamorous parts of creative independence: choosing work, protecting attention, pricing with confidence and letting a body of work compound.
It is not a hustle manual. It is a companion for the long middle of a creative career, when the early excitement has settled and you want something more durable.
includes: Reading list of 30 books that shaped the essays

title: Slow Growth
summary: A practical handbook for turning creative skills into a small, sustainable income.
description: Slow Growth walks through building a creative business one layer at a time: a clear offer, a small audience that trusts you, and products that keep earning while you make new work.
Every chapter ends with a short exercise, so you finish the book with a plan rather than a list of ideas.

title: Field Notes System
summary: A Notion workspace for ideas, projects and clients — calm, minimal and fully linked.
description: Field Notes is the Notion system the studio runs on. It connects an idea garden, project boards, a client CRM and a simple content calendar, so nothing lives in five different apps.
It is deliberately minimal: a handful of databases, clear views and no automation you have to maintain.

title: Editorial Portfolio Kit
summary: Figma layouts for presenting creative work like a printed magazine.
description: Forty editorial page layouts for case studies, project pages and pitch decks. Built on an 8pt grid with auto-layout, typographic styles and swappable image frames.
Use it for your portfolio site, a PDF portfolio or client presentations.
includes: Export presets for PDF and web

title: Proposal & Invoice Set
summary: Elegant, editable documents for proposals, contracts and invoices.
description: Six business documents designed to make small studios look as considered as their work: a project proposal, scope of work, contract outline, invoice, receipt and project wrap-up.
Available for Google Docs, Pages and Word.

title: Brand from Scratch
summary: A step-by-step guide to naming, positioning and designing a personal brand.
description: A focused guide to the decisions behind a personal brand: what you stand for, who you serve, how you sound and how it all looks.
Written for independent creators who want a brand that can grow with them for years.

title: Pricing Creative Work
summary: How to price projects, products and retainers without guesswork.
description: A short, direct guide to pricing: day rates versus value pricing, packaging services, pricing digital products and raising prices with existing clients.
Includes a calculator spreadsheet you can adapt to your own costs.

title: Organic Shapes Library
summary: 240 hand-drawn botanical and biomorphic shapes as editable vectors.
description: A library of leaves, stems, seeds and soft abstract forms, drawn by hand and cleaned into precise vectors.
Every shape comes as SVG, AI and PNG, ready for brand work, editorial layouts and web.

title: Paper Texture Pack
summary: 36 high-resolution scans of natural, handmade and recycled papers.
description: Subtle paper textures scanned at 1200dpi to add warmth to digital work without looking like a filter.
Each texture is tileable and prepared for overlay blending.

title: The Creator's Almanac
summary: A yearly planner and seasonal journal for creative work. Arriving next spring.
description: A seasonal planner that follows the rhythm of a creative year: planting ideas, tending projects, harvesting results and resting.
Join the newsletter to hear first when it is ready.

title: Visual Voice Workshop
summary: A self-paced video workshop on finding a distinctive visual style.
description: A small online workshop in six lessons on developing a visual voice that feels like yours — from references and constraints to a repeatable process.
Join the newsletter to hear first when enrolment opens.
